title: Qt: Internals: Dissector Tables: Allow searching name or description
description:
Allow searching the name and description separately, similar to Enabled
Protocols. Allow regex. Use the Qt features for recursive searching and
showing parents of matches (added in 5.10 and 6.0, respectively) instead
of doing our own.
